majagers-q4-2026-7k2q9c.headline: Your business already has personality. CARBON° helps the whole customer experience look and work like it.
majagers-q4-2026-7k2q9c.subhead: A low-cost, high-return revitalization concept designed for the Q4 / festive trading window — with visible work beginning quickly once scope and access are approved.
majagers-q4-2026-7k2q9c.visual_note: The original Majager's visual concept remains part of the proposal. CARBON° should preserve recognizable real-business context and improve it, not replace it with generic AI-looking imagery.

visuals.title: Existing business → recognizable transformation
visuals.note: Use actual Majager's frontage/profile context wherever permission and asset rights allow.

visuals.title: PLACE° concept
visuals.note: Compact gazebo in the driveway, parallel with the street, facing toward the existing covered/social area; driveway remains usable; no decorative trees/planters.

visuals.title: SOCIAL° concept
visuals.note: A coherent Majager's social system: specials, events, branded promotions, responses and repeatable content rather than isolated artwork.

market_context.context: FNB/BER South African Consumer Confidence Index, Q3 2026: improved from Q2, but still negative.
Active social-media user identities reported for South Africa in the Digital 2026 report.
One current public SA benchmark: one platform and eight posts per month from Social Media SA.
Sage reports 73% of surveyed South African SMBs invested in AI, while 47% use AI to drive revenue growth.

offer.title: 14-Day CARBON° Proof
offer.summary: A paid, tightly scoped proof period designed to show useful visible work before Majager's commits to a larger managed relationship.
offer.price_note: Current portal is a draft. The 24-hour quote clock starts only when CARBON° issues a final priced version.

included.name: SOCIAL°
included.detail: Profile/presentation cleanup plus a repeatable promotional system, including agreed Friday/Saturday campaign cadence.

included.name: BRAND°
included.detail: Bring existing Majager's identity into a more deliberate, consistent customer-facing system.

included.name: PLACE°
included.detail: Practical frontage/gazebo/paint/signage concept focused on visible impact without a large rebuild.

included.name: CARE°
included.detail: Define how customer queries/reviews are handled so routine engagement does not depend on the owner being available.

modules.name: SOCIAL°
modules.description: Promotions, posts, community responses, content system and reporting.

modules.name: BRAND°
modules.description: Identity refinement, templates, signage, menus and reusable brand assets.

modules.name: PLACE°
modules.description: Low-cost physical revitalization and customer-space concepts.

modules.name: CARE°
modules.description: Customer questions, reviews and routine response workflows.

modules.name: LOYALTY°

modules.name: SELL°

modules.name: STOCK°
modules.description: Stock visibility, reorder prompts, rotation and promotion intelligence.

modules.name: POS°
modules.description: Point-of-sale and order-flow modernization where useful.

modules.name: APP°
modules.description: Lightweight web/PWA or fuller application only when the business case supports it.

modules.name: INTELLIGENCE°
modules.description: Turn customer and operating data into practical decisions.
